evidence: Introduces a new common BIP 352 module (src/common/bip352.cpp and bip352.h) implementing cryptographic primitives and ECDH shared-secret calculations.
rationale: Implements shared BIP 352 cryptographic utilities in common code for use by wallet, RPC, and future node index components. Primitives involving elliptic curve operations require careful review to prevent subtle protocol or security flaws across consumers.
